Select IC50 activity records against target CHEMBL4005. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then assays on assay_id, then target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join to require canonical SMILES. Join docs on activities.doc_id to obtain provenance. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL4005 and standard_type IC50. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key from compound_records joined on activities.record_id, pubmed_id_or_doi preferring pubmed_id with doi as fallback, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Do not deduplicate; keep all qualifying activity rows.
